name: Age-Gated Eligibility (AGE)
definition: An age-gated densification-eligibility rule that defers a new primitive’s first split-or-clone decision until it has matured, damping the densification cascade and bounding the primitive budget.
summary: Age-Gated Eligibility is a densification control mechanism that prevents newly created 3D Gaussian primitives from splitting or cloning until they reach a fixed maturity threshold, thereby preventing uncontrolled cascading growth.
